operating_notes.text: Outstanding borrowing was ₹59.85 Cr as on 31 March 2026, keeping the company outside SEBI's Large Corporate framework.

Income Tax Department conducted a search and seizure operation from September 4 to September 9, 2025; a notice u/s 158BC for block assessment was received and the impact is presently not ascertainable.
The Company's land lease with the Government of Gujarat expired on July 31, 2018; the Company is confident of renewal and the entire production facility is on this leased land.
The Company invested GBP 15 million in Clas-SiC Wafer Fab Limited, U.K. and USD 12 million in Offgrid Energy Labs Inc, Delaware, USA (18.14% stake subscribed).
SiCSem executed a Fiscal Support Agreement with ISM for a ₹2,067 Cr Silicon Carbide semiconductor fab and ATMP facility in Bhubaneswar.
Bromine production has recovered to historical daily levels of around 50-55 tons per day.
Wholly owned subsidiary Acume Chemicals Private Limited reported FY24-25 turnover of ₹81.12 Cr and total assets of ₹286.50 Cr as of March 31, 2026.

timeline.summary: Chemikas Speciality LLP submitted its annual Regulation 31(4) SEBI SAST declaration confirming no new share encumbrances beyond previously disclosed levels.
P Ranjit, as Promoter, declared no new encumbrances on Archean Chemical Industries Limited’s shares as of April 1, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).

Archean Chemical disclosed on 30 April 2026 that it is not a Large Corporate under SEBI's framework, with outstanding borrowing of ₹59.85 Cr at 31 March 2026 and a CRISIL A/Negative rating (outlook revised from Stable, rating reaffirmed).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹300.94 Cr (-12.9% YoY), net profit ₹12.23 Cr (-77.2% YoY).
Board of Directors recommended final dividend of ₹2.50 per share (125%) for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval on June 12, 2026.
Archean Chemical submitted its revised Large Corporate disclosure for FY26 confirming ₹77.43 Cr in borrowings and a CRISIL A/Negative rating.
On May 11, 2026, subsidiary SiCSem executed a Fiscal Support Agreement with the India Semiconductor Mission for a ₹2,067 Cr Silicon Carbide fab project.
Archean Chemical Industries Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 results on May 13, 2026, via its website.
On May 13, 2026, Archean Chemical Industries held its Q4 FY26 earnings call discussing financial results and project updates.
Archean Chemical announced a board-approved investment of up to ₹170 Cr in the rights issue of its wholly owned subsidiary Acume Chemicals.
CRISIL downgrades Archean Chemical to A-/Stable from A/Negative as rated debt jumps to ₹1,531 Cr
